resources.string: Accessibility can read Facebook UI labels. Optional, separately approved experimental Auto Skip can dispatch up to 3 swipes and show Stop / approximate Back controls. No screenshots, account info or post text are saved.
Read-only ad candidate and post boundary probe

Read-only ad diagnostics by default. Separate supervised Auto Skip experiment can perform up to 3 approximate swipes with Stop / Back control. It can skip normal posts; a reverse swipe does not guarantee exact restoration.

Accessibility can technically read on-screen content and interact with apps. FeedVeil reads limited Facebook UI labels by default. If you separately arm the trial, it may swipe Facebook automatically; it can make mistakes. The service also reads only app package names on window changes to remove controls after switching apps. It does not save post contents, names, passwords, screenshots, or send data anywhere. You can pause or revoke permission at any time.
Only aggregated counters and your local consent/pause settings are stored. No Facebook content is retained. Not affiliated with Meta.
To test, grant access, open the original Facebook app, scroll manually, return here and tap Refresh. Record your observations manually using the Phase 0 test sheet.
Choose Feed or Reels BEFORE opening Facebook. Each selection starts a fresh counter session. This is YOUR test label, not automatic screen recognition.

Only for an owner-supervised test. Select Feed or Reels above, then explicitly arm. Max 3 swipes in 5 min, 15-second cooldown. Wrong skips are possible. The overlay has Stop and approximate Back; exact history cannot be reconstructed. Do not use for unattended browsing.
Experimental swipes are ARMED until stopped, session expires, or 3 skips are attempted.

FeedVeil may incorrectly skip normal Facebook posts. You must stay on the selected Feed or Reels screen. The floating Stop button stops the trial; Back tries one reverse swipe, NOT a guaranteed return to the skipped post. Max 3 automatic swipes within 5 minutes, with a cooldown. No screenshots, content, account identifiers or post history are stored. This is not an ad blocker or validated classifier.
Only provisional containers, not verified ads. Placement clusters are not unique ads. No automatic actions.
